sources.description: Original input FLAC audio of 张碧晨《年轮》.
Decoded PCM WAV from the original FLAC.
Separated dry vocal stem from MelBand Roformer.
Whisper ASR transcription segments (phrase-level timing cross-check).
GAME transcription note events (note grid for melisma splits).
RMVPE frame-level pitch extraction (10ms, independent detector).
HubertFA forced alignment word/phone boundaries (identity and count only).
Agent-authored score with 51 phrases and per-phrase phonation curves.
Native pitch export of the current score (OpenUtau Core).
Native phoneme export of the current score.
Native environment and asset provenance receipt.
